faq_heading: Downtown condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Downtown. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Downtown, New Westminster: 96 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 15 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 2 of 14 New Westminster communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Downtown fell from 107 in June to 96 in October (−10.3%), and 65 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 23.2% of New Westminster’s 413 condos and townhomes listed.

blocks.text: Downtown home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

133 condos sold in Downtown with a median price of $519,900 (the middle half sold between $450,000 and $593,500), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $662 per square foot, a median year built of 2007 and a median strata fee of $496 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Downtown?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 96 condos and townhomes listed in Downtown. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Downtown a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Downtown had a sales ratio of 16%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Downtown from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 65 condos and townhomes sold in Downtown over those 5 months, out of 327 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in Downtown sell for?
faq.a: 133 condos sold in Downtown between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $519,900.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Downtown?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
